answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Border crossing record with passport stamp history is the check: stamps in one passport showing regular crossings for years. A farm faking 209 aliases needs 209 separate stamp histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the canyon signal is public, the grove check is automatic, and 209 aliases cost 209 times what one real agent costs, with the zenith trail open to all.
